meta_title: Streamlity — Free IPTV Player for Windows, macOS and Linux
meta_description: Streamlity is a free, open-source IPTV player for Windows, macOS and Linux. Play M3U playlists and provider accounts with a TV guide, catch-up, multiview and 12 languages.
hero_title: A beautiful home for your IPTV.
hero_sub: Streamlity plays live TV, movies and series from your own M3U playlist or provider account, with a program guide, catch-up and multiview built in.
demo_label: Interactive preview of the Streamlity live TV screen. Pick a channel from the list.
demo_caption: Try it: pick a channel. Every name here is made up, and Streamlity comes with no channels of its own.
features_sub: Bring the playlist you already have. Streamlity turns it into a fast, tidy TV experience on your desktop.
card_live_title: Live TV with a real guide
card_live_text: Load your XMLTV guide and see what’s on now and next for every channel. The guide is cached, so it opens instantly the next time. Missed something? Watch it again with catch-up on channels that keep an archive.
card_multi_title: Up to four channels at once
card_multi_text: Follow several matches or news channels side by side, then switch the one you hear with a click.
card_vod_text: Browse your provider’s library by category and pick up every movie and episode right where you stopped.
card_search_text: One search across channels, movies and series. Hide the categories you never watch and reorder the rest.
card_lock_text: Lock categories behind a 4-digit PIN. Locked content stays out of search, home and history.
card_vsr_text: On Windows with an RTX graphics card, RTX Video Super Resolution upscales low-resolution channels so they look clean on a big screen.
vsr_slider: Compare the original and the upscaled picture
card_langs_text: Streamlity follows your system language, including right-to-left Arabic. Change it any time in Settings.
dl_sub: Free on every platform. No sign-up, nothing to pay, ever.
dl_win_note: The installer doesn’t need admin rights. If Windows SmartScreen warns you, choose More info, then Run anyway.
dl_mac_req: macOS 12 or later, Apple silicon and Intel
dl_mac_note: Drag Streamlity to Applications. The first time, open System Settings › Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway.
dl_linux_note: Needs GTK 3, libmpv 2 and libsecret. Install the .deb with sudo apt install ./Streamlity-*.deb
trust_sub: Streamlity doesn’t have accounts, servers or analytics. It’s just a player on your computer.
trust_1_text: Playlists, history and favorites are stored on your computer and go nowhere else.
trust_2_text: Provider credentials are saved in the operating system’s secure storage, not in a plain file.
trust_3_text: The full source code is on GitHub under the GPL-3.0 license, and every release is built from it.

faq.a: No. Streamlity is only a player. It doesn’t include, sell or link to any channels or content. You need a playlist or subscription from a provider, and you’re responsible for making sure you’re allowed to watch what it offers.
Yes. Streamlity is free and open source under the GPL-3.0 license. There are no ads, no subscriptions and no account to create.

faq.q: Which playlist formats does it support?
faq.a: M3U and M3U8 playlists from a URL or a local file, and Xtream Codes accounts. Program guides use the XMLTV format.

faq.q: Which systems does it run on?
faq.a: Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit), macOS 12 or later on Apple silicon and Intel, and Linux (x64), with a .deb package for Ubuntu 24.04+ and Debian 13+ and a .tar.gz for other distributions.

faq.q: Can I watch more than one channel at a time?
faq.a: Yes. Multiview shows up to four channels at once in 16:9 tiles, with a fullscreen grid.

faq.q: Where are my playlists and passwords stored?
faq.a: On your own computer. Playlist passwords are kept in the operating system’s secure storage, and Streamlity doesn’t send your data anywhere.

faq.q: How do I change the language?
faq.a: Streamlity follows your system language automatically. You can pick any of the 12 languages in Settings.

close_title: Your playlist, ready in a minute.
close_sub: Download Streamlity, add your playlist and start watching.
disclaimer: Streamlity is a media player. It does not provide, host or sell any TV channels, movies or other content.
